key.name: lockscreen-mode
key.description: Visual style of the lock screen. WACK is the classic GNOME-compliant mode; Cupertino emulates macOS Sonoma style.

key.name: cupertino-always-show-user
key.summary: Always show user widget in Cupertino mode
key.description: If true, the user widget is always shown in Cupertino mode. Notifications are hidden by default but can be toggled by pressing Shift+N.

key.name: cupertino-unlock-fade
key.description: If true, unlocking in Cupertino mode plays a fade-out animation with a panel slide-in (automatically disabled when Power Saver mode is active). Disable for an instant unlock.

key.name: cupertino-crossfade-speed
key.description: Speed preset for the unlock crossfade animation. Values: 'slow', 'normal', 'fast'.

key.name: clock-animation
key.description: Animation applied to the date and time while opening the authentication prompt.

key.name: prompt-animation
key.description: Animation applied to the authentication prompt while it appears.

key.name: enable-unblank
key.description: Prevent the screen/monitor from blanking or turning off when locked.

key.name: unblank-on-ac-only
key.description: Only keep the screen on if the system is plugged into AC power.

key.name: esc-to-sleep
key.description: Pressing Escape on the lock screen immediately blanks/sleeps the display (or suspends the system if Keep Screen On is disabled).

key.name: prompt-vibrancy
key.description: Applies dynamic color to the password field based on wallpaper colors.

key.name: cursor-blink
key.description: Enable or disable text cursor blinking in the password entry field.

key.name: cupertino-lockscreen-message-enable
key.description: Show a custom message on the lock screen in Cupertino mode.

key.name: cupertino-lockscreen-message-text
key.description: The text to display on the lock screen in Cupertino mode.

key.name: lockscreen-wallpaper-enable
key.description: Use a custom image overlay as the lock screen background.

key.name: lockscreen-wallpaper-path
key.description: File path to the custom lock screen wallpaper image.

key.name: background-source
key.description: Live video, GNOME desktop wallpaper, or a still image overlay.

key.name: prompt-pause-video
key.summary: Pause video when the password prompt appears

key.name: prompt-grayscale
key.summary: Grayscale video when the password prompt appears

key.name: prompt-change-blur
key.summary: Change video blur when the password prompt appears

key.name: prompt-blur-radius
key.summary: Video blur radius on password prompt
